acceptance_status_vocabulary.pending: not built on main: no code for the behaviour (the dependency is in `depends_on`)
acceptance_status_vocabulary.built: code on main; no acceptance.md row exercises the behaviour, or one covers only part of it (named in `remaining`). `accepted_revision` is the implementing commit
acceptance_status_vocabulary.accepted-simulator: an acceptance.md row recorded on the iOS simulator exercises the row's primary behaviour and its Result does not exclude it. `accepted_revision` is the revision that row ran on; the S1b.17 fidelity items it did not record stay in `remaining`
acceptance_status_vocabulary.accepted-device: as accepted-simulator, on a physical device
acceptance_status_vocabulary.deployed: the app build carrying it is distributed (TestFlight / store / production web), not only a service deploy
acceptance_status_vocabulary.mainnet-verified: exercised on Monad mainnet with a recorded transaction
acceptance_status_vocabulary.blocked: cannot progress without something outside the builders' hands: a ledger blocker code (B1–B12), a provider, or a user step; named in `blocked_by`
acceptance_status_vocabulary.excluded: a recorded decision removes it (D-194, D-195, or the binding D-029); named in `excluded_by`; nothing is owed
